accessibility.description: The iOS game supports VoiceOver for its text-based real-time strategy interface. AppleVis reports readable controls, military statistics, and campaign powers. An extra-slow speed setting gives screen-reader users more time to review resources and issue orders; the game still requires timed decisions.
